St Peregrine A blessing with the relic of St Peregrine can be obtained after Mass every Frid ay at 10am. This kindly Saint, born in Italy in 1260, is the Patron Saint of cancer patients. A very kind donation of €2000 was given towards Mary’s Meals. That donation along with the €1950 already donated will be greatly appreciated by the Charity. Anointing – I would like to celebrate the anointing of these who are sick in our Parish, commencing during December. People who feel the need for healing in body, mind or spirit should avail of this Holy Sacrament. A date will be announced shortly. We should keep in mind the need to offer transport to anyone living on their own. Thank you. The film on Fatima & the presence of the Statue of Our Lady is of great importance. In 1917, Our Lady appeared with the message for people to be converted through the Rosary. As we approach Christmas, it is necessary to take the opportunity to go to confession before receiving Holy Communion. I encourage this practice to children especially.
